variant: hotkey=parseAccel(cmd.accel), size="md", tone="inherit"; rendered only when the command has an accel
purpose: Shows the keyboard shortcut for the command at the right edge of its row.
text: No text node; modifiers are Icons keyboard_command_key (command), keyboard_option_key (option) and shift (shift). Shortcuts shown: ⌘ \ Toggle preview; ⌘ ⌥ S Toggle split view; ⌘ ⇧ H Show / hide completed; ⌘ ⌥ - Collapse all; ⌘ ⌥ = Expand all; ⌘ N New task; ⌘ F Search this list; ⌘ Z Undo; ⌘ ⇧ Z Redo; ⌘ ⇧ N New list; ⌘ ⇧ P New project; ⌘ , Settings. Palette-search: ⌘ N, ⌘ ⇧ N, ⌘ ⇧ P.
states: inherits row colour (tone inherit), so it changes with the active row
look: Modifier spans 13x13, font 400 13px/13px; key letters 400 12px/18px; colour inherits the row colour (oklch(0.62 0.013 264) in default rows, shot). No keycap border captured.
region: Results list (right edge of command rows)

variant: recording=false, idle. Shows the HotkeyHint glyph sequence. Width 49px or 52px (per shot.png) for the three-glyph combos; the 101px width is used only while recording.
purpose: Keycap button that shows the current combo. Clicking it starts recording for that row.
text: Per-row glyphs (B): Capture bar keyboard_command_key keyboard_return; Screenshot capture keyboard_command_key shift keyboard_return; New task / Search / Toggle preview / Open settings / Switch to list 1-9 / Select all tasks / Command palette / Undo keyboard_command_key; Delete task keyboard_command_key backspace; Previous list tab keyboard_command_key keyboard_option_key arrow_back; Next list tab keyboard_command_key keyboard_option_key arrow_forward; Previous project and Next project keyboard_command_key shift; Move task up keyboard_command_key keyboard_option_key arrow_upward; Move task down keyboard_command_key keyboard_option_key arrow_downward; Toggle split view, Focus other pane, Collapse all, Expand all keyboard_command_key keyboard_option_key; New list, New project, Show/hide completed, Redo keyboard_command_key shift; Clear capture draft keyboard_command_key shift backspace.
behaviour: Click starts recording for this row. Clicking the same row again while it is recording cancels (useHotkeyEditor.ts:121-124).
look: Box 21px tall; 49px or 52px wide; fill oklch(0.944 0.003 255); text oklch(0.46 0.013 262); font 400 11px/16.5px; radius 4.375px; right edge x 1153. Variant counts (B): Command plus one key 18; Command plus Shift 8; Command plus Option 8.

variant: recording=true. Width 101 at 1051,238 in the New task row (state:settings-shot-recording line 50). The HotkeyHint child is dropped.
purpose: Recording keycap. It shows the prompt while the window captures the next keypress.
behaviour: Next keydown is captured. Escape cancels the recording. Bare Backspace or Delete unbinds the row (sets accel to empty). Any other combo is assigned. Clicking this keycap again cancels (useHotkeyEditor.ts:73-96, 121-124).
look: Box [1051,238,101,21]; text colour oklch(0.6 0.2 255) (blue); fill oklch(0.944 0.003 255); font 400 11px/16.5px; radius 4.375px; thin blue outline visible in shot.png (width not measured).
